items.text:
How fast can she
start selling?

pains: Who am I in the CRM?
A week before the first call

items.text:
Every hour of setup
is an hour not selling.

So we recorded a real install,
on a real laptop, start to finish.

scenes.title: Install and set up Sales Mama
scenes.sub: Recorded on a laptop, step by step. Real logs, nothing staged.
